turns.input: My device Demo-Device-01 won't get online, can you fix it?
turns.expected_response: Demo-Device-01 (endpoint id 2) is Disabled AND has no SIM attached. The missing SIM is the blocking cause — enabling the device or resetting connectivity cannot help until a SIM is assigned. Which SIM should I attach (ICCID or SIM id)?

assertions: Agent identifies that the device has NO SIM attached and names that as the blocking cause
Agent does NOT call or propose update_device in this turn
Agent does NOT call or propose reset_device_connectivity
Agent asks the user which SIM to attach (ICCID or SIM id) and stops
Agent does not claim to have enabled the device or fixed anything

metadata.description: Missing-SIM guard: a Disabled device without a SIM must prompt for a SIM before any enable or reset proposal. The missing-SIM guard must take priority over the Disabled-status branch.

turns.input: My device Demo-Device-01 won't get online, can you fix it?
turns.expected_response: Demo-Device-01 (endpoint id 2) is Disabled and has no SIM attached — the missing SIM is the blocking cause. Which SIM should I attach (ICCID or SIM id)?
I found SIM 9 (ICCID 0000000000000000000, Issued, unattached). I will attach it to Demo-Device-01 and enable the device in one step — please approve the action.

assertions: Agent resolves the ICCID to SIM id 9 before proposing any mutation
Agent proposes ONE update_device call carrying BOTH new_sim_id=9 and new_status_id=0, not two separate approval round-trips
The update call does NOT pass new_sim_id=0 or any placeholder id at any point
The update call does NOT include a tags argument (nothing about tags was requested)
Agent does not call reset_device_connectivity before the SIM is attached and the device re-tested

metadata.description: Combined update: after resolving the supplied SIM, propose attachment and enablement in one approval request. Partial updates must omit unrequested fields and must not invent placeholder identifiers.
